notes: Page presents the Nordyne serial system under the AirBloc-Nordyne heading; parent stated as Nortek (formerly Nordyne Manufacturing). Page lists related Nordyne-family brands (Ambirad, Benson, Broan, Frigidaire, Gibson, Intertherm, Kelvinator, Manmouth, Maytag, Miller, Nordyne, Nutone, Philco, Reznor, Tappan, Ventrol, Westinghouse) but does not state they share this system, so no sister is claimed and no usesStylesOf is set; styles are transcribed from this page in full. COORDINATOR CORRECTION (Wave 3): page Style 2 (F3891 4228) NOW SHIPPED as 1989, superseding the Wave 1/2 hold. The digit-counting reading (91 -> 1991) is falsified by this page's own examples: under digit-only counting, style 1's example GBB030708229 would give year 70 and month 82 (not a month), and the E2E style example would give year 50 (1950, below the 1960 floor). Character counting is therefore this page's unique coherent convention, and it decodes every example on the page. The Nordyne file's 16-character style is a different system on a different page and does not govern this page's convention. The NORDYNE-2 diagram read is no longer the unblocker for this style (it remains a welcome confirmation). The same correction ships on the Benson, Ambirad, and Airbloc pages. (File id style-3: this is page Style 2, appended after the merged style to preserve existing style ids.) Page Styles 3, 4 (first listing) and 5 (second listing headed Style 4) collapse to one normalized style: dash/space placement differs but normalization strips both, leaving the same 12-character shape and the same year/month positions; all three page examples are kept as examples of the merged style.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based, counting all characters). Same serial, positions and decode as the repo Nordyne style-1, corroborating this reading.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter-digit-letter + 9 digits (page Styles 3, 4 and 5 merged under normalization)
styles.notes: Page Style 3 example G6R9905-05028 (year 4th-5th, month 6th-7th); page Style 4 example M 1 G 9807 - 05432 (same positions); page Style 5 (second Style 4 heading) example E2E-9705 01234 (year 5th-6th, month 7th-8th counting the dash, which is exactly positions [3,5]/[5,7] once the dash is stripped). All three normalize to the same shape with the same date positions, so one style carries all three examples.

styles.era: 9-character serials, 1 letter followed by 8 digits (page Style 2)
styles.notes: Page Style 2 example shown as F3891 4228 (space not counted). Year = 3rd & 4th characters (1-based) = [2,4] on the normalized serial -> 1989. File id is style-3 to preserve existing ids; see file notes for why character counting is this page's convention.
